claims.claim: 起點是這個 repo 的第一個 commit，它只有一個 `/healthz` 端點：`cmd/api/main.go` 有 `/healthz`，沒有 `/products`；沒有 `internal/service/product.go`、`internal/repository/product.go`，也沒有 `RequestLog`。
claims.claim_en: The starting point is the first commit of this repo, and it has only a `/healthz` endpoint: `cmd/api/main.go` has `/healthz` and no `/products`; there is no `internal/service/product.go`, no `internal/repository/product.go`, and no `RequestLog`.

claims.claim: 程式分在 `cmd` 與 `internal`：`cmd/api/main.go` 是 `package main` 的進入點；`internal` 底下有 `handler`、`service`、`repository` 三個套件。`internal/platform` 目前只有 `.gitkeep`，沒有 Go 程式。
claims.claim_en: The code lives in `cmd` and `internal`: `cmd/api/main.go` is the `package main` entry point, and `internal` holds three packages, `handler`, `service` and `repository`. `internal/platform` holds only `.gitkeep` and no Go code.

claims.claim: 三層的分工寫在各套件的說明註解：`handler` 是 HTTP 層，`service` 放業務邏輯，`repository` 是資料存取層。依賴方向是 `handler` 到 `service` 到 `repository`：`handler` 只 import `service`；`service` 只 import `repository`；`repository` 不 import `service` 或 `handler`；`service` 不 import `handler`；`handler` 不 import `repository`。
claims.claim_en: Each package's doc comment states its job: `handler` is the HTTP layer, `service` holds business logic, `repository` is the data access layer. Dependencies point one way, `handler` to `service` to `repository`: `handler` imports only `service`; `service` imports only `repository`; `repository` imports neither `service` nor `handler`; `service` does not import `handler`; `handler` does not import `repository`.

checks.text: // Package handler is the HTTP layer
// Package service holds the business logic
// Package repository is the data access layer

claims.claim: `cmd/api/main.go` 的 `main` 用三行手寫的呼叫接線：`repository.NewMemoryProducts()`、`service.NewProductService(repo)`、`handler.New(svc, logger)`。埠號讀環境變數 `PORT`，沒設就用 `8080`。`go.mod` 只有 `chi` 一個依賴，沒有 DI 容器套件，也沒有資料庫或 Redis 的套件。
claims.claim_en: In `cmd/api/main.go`, `main` wires the layers with three hand-written calls: `repository.NewMemoryProducts()`, `service.NewProductService(repo)`, `handler.New(svc, logger)`. The port comes from the `PORT` environment variable and defaults to `8080`. `go.mod` has one dependency, `chi`: no DI container package and no database or Redis package.

claims.claim: 把 `cmd/api/main.go` 裡 `service.NewProductService(repo)` 的參數拿掉，`go build ./cmd/api` 失敗，錯誤訊息含 `not enough arguments in call to service.NewProductService`。
claims.claim_en: After removing the argument from `service.NewProductService(repo)` in `cmd/api/main.go`, `go build ./cmd/api` fails with `not enough arguments in call to service.NewProductService`.

checks.output_contains: not enough arguments in call to service.NewProductService

claims.claim: `ProductStore` 介面宣告在使用它的 `service` 套件，只列一個方法 `List`；`service` 只有一處呼叫 `s.store`。`repository.MemoryProducts` 有 `List` 方法，沒有任何提到 `ProductStore` 的宣告，`repository` 套件也沒有 import `service`。整個專案編譯通過。
claims.claim_en: The `ProductStore` interface is declared in the `service` package that uses it and lists one method, `List`; `service` calls `s.store` in one place. `repository.MemoryProducts` has a `List` method, nothing in `repository` mentions `ProductStore`, and `repository` does not import `service`. The project builds.

claims.claim: `handler.New` 用 `chi` 建立 router，回傳 `net/http` 的 `http.Handler`。它註冊兩條路由：`GET /healthz` 與 `GET /products`，並用 `r.Use(RequestLog(logger))` 掛上日誌 middleware。
claims.claim_en: `handler.New` builds a `chi` router and returns `http.Handler` from `net/http`. It registers two routes, `GET /healthz` and `GET /products`, and attaches the logging middleware with `r.Use(RequestLog(logger))`.

claims.claim: `RequestLog` 的型別是 `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`。它先記下開始時間，再呼叫 `next.ServeHTTP`，最後用 `slog` 記錄 `method`、`path`、`status`、`duration_ms` 四個欄位。狀態碼來自 `statusRecorder`：它包住 `ResponseWriter`，`WriteHeader` 先記下狀態碼再交給原本的 `ResponseWriter`。
claims.claim_en: `RequestLog` has the type `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`. It records the start time, calls `next.ServeHTTP`, then logs four fields with `slog`: `method`, `path`, `status`, `duration_ms`. The status code comes from `statusRecorder`, which wraps the `ResponseWriter`: `WriteHeader` stores the code and then passes it on.

claims.claim: `main` 用 `log/slog` 的 JSON handler 把日誌寫到 `os.Stdout`，所以每筆日誌是一行 JSON。
claims.claim_en: `main` uses the JSON handler of `log/slog` and writes to `os.Stdout`, so each log record is one line of JSON.

claims.claim: `TestRoutes` 是 table-driven 測試，表裡有 6 個情境：`/healthz` 回 200、`/products` 有資料、`/products` 空清單回 `[]`、service 出錯回 500、不存在的路徑回 404、`POST /products` 回 405。測試用 `httptest` 直接呼叫 router，沒有啟動伺服器。`go test ./...` 全部通過。
claims.claim_en: `TestRoutes` is table-driven with 6 cases: `/healthz` returns 200, `/products` with data, `/products` with an empty list returns `[]`, a service error returns 500, an unknown path returns 404, and `POST /products` returns 405. It calls the router through `httptest` and starts no server. `go test ./...` passes.

checks.text: {"products with data", http.MethodGet, "/products", fakeLister{items: two}, http.StatusOK, 2}
{"products empty list returns []", http.MethodGet, "/products", fakeLister{}, http.StatusOK, 0}
{"products service error", http.MethodGet, "/products", fakeLister{err: errors.New("x")}, http.StatusInternalServerError, -1}

claims.claim: `repository.NewMemoryProducts` 內建 3 件商品：機械式鍵盤 2490 元、人體工學滑鼠 1290 元、27 吋螢幕 5990 元。`GET /products` 回傳的 JSON 每件商品有 `id`、`name`、`price_twd` 三個欄位。
claims.claim_en: `repository.NewMemoryProducts` has 3 built-in products: a mechanical keyboard at 2490 TWD, an ergonomic mouse at 1290 TWD and a 27-inch monitor at 5990 TWD. `GET /products` returns JSON where each product has the three fields `id`, `name` and `price_twd`.

claims.claim: ASP.NET Core 用 `AddScoped` 在服務容器登記介面與實作，由容器建立物件。Java 的 Spring 用 `@Autowired` 註解，由容器注入依賴。
claims.claim_en: ASP.NET Core registers an interface and its implementation in the service container with `AddScoped`, and the container creates the object. Java's Spring injects dependencies from its container with the `@Autowired` annotation.

claims.claim: Go 的工具鏈規定：放在 `internal` 目錄底下的套件，只有 `internal` 上一層目錄樹裡的程式碼能 import。
claims.claim_en: The Go toolchain allows a package under an `internal` directory to be imported only by code in the directory tree rooted at the parent of `internal`.
